warmup_observations.note: Warm-up rows remain in the daily file with missing metrics because no full trailing window exists yet.

conventions.realised_volatility: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of trailing returns through the date, annualised by sqrt(252)
conventions.var: linear empirical quantile at confidence of prior-window positive losses (-log return)
conventions.expected_shortfall: mean of prior-window losses greater than or equal to the empirical VaR threshold
conventions.breach: current realised loss > VaR estimated from prior observations only
conventions.gap_policy: gap-spanning returns are retained, as in ReturnSeries, and remain part of trailing windows
